verdict.rationale: Hatchet orchestrates AI agents, so consuming MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this kind of product. The only MCP-related evidence (hatchet-docs-7, the 'Hatchet Agent Tools' cookbook) goes the other way: it exposes Hatchet workflows as tools for external agent SDKs to invoke. Nothing in the pack shows Hatchet connecting to MCP servers and using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
